text:
maria: Heads up — ApexConnect reported p99 token-gen spikes on Dedicated pool-7 since ~02:15 UTC. CS escalated to P1. Need an owner, a short workaround we can offer the customer, and an ETA for a fix. Logs: https://redwood.logs/s/abc123

kevin: On it. Can someone confirm the exact failure mode? Is this latency-only or are we seeing 5xx errors?

maria: Mostly tail latency spikes (p99). No 5xxs in the initial window. Traces show stalls on KV-cache misses. Example trace id: trace-22b.

jamal: I can take model routing/batching look. @kevin can you grab a heap/profile from pool-7? Also @olivia — can you check autoscaler thresholds for that pool?

olivia: Looks like autoscaler didn't trigger (pool at 72% util, threshold 80%). I'll bump min replicas to avoid cold starts. Applying quick patch: `kubectl patch hpa ded-pool-7 --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}'`

sre-bot: Incident created — INC-2026-0427-ApexConnect-p1. Oncall rotation notified.

kevin: I pulled a sample log via the trace endpoint: ```2026-04-27T02:18:23Z WARN kv_cache miss for key=userid:443 -> fetch 120ms``` Looks like KV backend latency spike. Paging infra.

jamal: Workaround proposal: route ApexConnect traffic to model-quantized-v2 on pool-5 (warm pool, lower tail p99). @maria — need approval, note slight output diffs possible.

maria: Approve temporary routing for 30m while infra mitigates — only if we can monitor diffs and rollback. CS should notify the customer. ETA for infra mitigation?

olivia: Applying routing change now via router-config: `route set apexconnect -> pool-5 model-quantized-v2 weight=100 for 30m`

kevin: @alejandra / infra team — can you check redis/kv cluster latencies? If KV is the bottleneck we should failover to replica and scale.

alejandra: Oncall infra here — confirmed redis pod GC spikes and high p99. Initiating replica failover and scaling +2 pods. Failover started 02:24 UTC.

maria: Thanks. @cust-succ-lee please tell the customer we applied the temporary routing and we'll follow up with timeline and diffs.

cust-succ-lee: Notified customer. They asked if output quality will change — we'll monitor diffs and share any regressions.

jamal: I'll open a quick PR to codify the routing change and a rollback step. Pinged @kevin for review: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4721

kevin: Reviewing now. Quick note for the PR: add an explicit fallback to `model-legacy` in router policy to avoid timeout cascades.

maria: Owner assignments: jamal (routing PR + rollback plan), alejandra (redis failover), olivia (autoscaler tuning), kevin (postmortem + traces). Next status update in 15m.

sre-bot: INC-2026-0427 update — routing change applied at 02:27 UTC; redis failover in progress; monitoring p99 and error rates.

alejandra: Failover completed 02:31 UTC. Redis latency recovered: p99 improved from ~1.2s -> ~230ms. Scaled +2 pods.

maria: Good. CS please confirm customer sees stable metrics. Jamal — after PR merge coordinate a canary shift back in 10m and confirm before full switch.

cust-succ-lee: Customer acknowledged and will watch their dashboards. They've asked for an incident summary by EOD.

kevin: Starting a postmortem template now. Will include KV-cache miss analysis and autoscaler thresholds. ETA for draft: 2 hours.

jamal: PR merged at 02:35 UTC. Canary ready; shifting 5% traffic now.

sre-bot: Routing canary set to 5% at 02:36 UTC. Observability hooks enabled.

maria: If canary stable for 10m, move to 50% then full. Keep pings here for any regressions.

kevin: Canary looks stable — canary p99 ~250ms. Proceeding to 50%.

jamal: Moving to 50% now. Monitoring for trace-22b pattern.

olivia: Autoscaler thresholds adjusted; will revert minReplicas when load normalizes.

sre-bot: INC-2026-0427 status: mitigated at 02:50 UTC. SLA risk reduced; will close incident once postmortem posted.

maria: Thanks team — recap of action items below:

— jamal: routing PR merged + monitor canary; coordinate full shift at stable -> DONE (02:35–02:50)
— alejandra: redis failover + scale (+2 pods) -> DONE (02:31)
— olivia: autoscaler tune -> DONE (02:28), will revert later
— kevin: postmortem draft ETA 2h; include KV-cache analysis and recommended autoscaler threshold change
— cust-succ-lee: customer notified and requested EOD summary

maria: Closing status update — will leave incident open until PM draft posted. If anything regresses reopen here. Thanks all.
